title: BCC optimality for the three-dimensional Coulomb lattice energy
summary: We prove that the body-centered cubic lattice uniquely minimizes the renormalized Coulomb energy among three-dimensional Bravais lattices of fixed covolume, up to orthogonal transformations. Using Ewald summation, we write the energy, to within an additive constant, as a sum of two positive, rapidly convergent series in real and reciprocal space. Their positivity provides finite lower bounds for all competitors. A passage to the dual lattice reduces the problem to a face-centered cubic comparison.
